## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix `requirement_proven` before merge: the new counting logic makes a requirement with no criteria count as proven, which reverses a safety check the PR body says should not change.

## Changes
The pull request replaces `typing.List`/`Dict` with built-in generics and `log.warn` with `log.warning` across 180 `app/handlers/h*_records.py` modules. It also switches `by_name` to `operator.itemgetter`, rewrites `requirement_proven` to compare a sum against `len(criteria)`, and adds a one-line `review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Return False when criteria is empty — An empty `criteria` list now makes `requirement_proven([])` return True, because `sum(...)` gives 0 and `len(criteria)` is 0. The removed `bool(criteria) and all(...)` returned False, and line 10 still logs "requirement has no criteria" before returning success. — A release-review requirement with no criteria is now reported as proven, which contradicts the PR's stated "No behavior change is intended." — Fix: Restore `bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)` and add an empty-list assertion to `test_requirement_proof` in `tests/test_handlers.py`, which currently tests only non-empty inputs.

- 177 of the 180 changed `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files were not read in full; this review checked their changed lines only by pattern-matching them against the typing-import, generic-annotation and `log.warning` substitutions.
